**Job Summary**
---------------


Black \& Veatch is seeking a SCADA engineering professional with a strong focus on Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to support the design, integration, and commissioning of utility\-scale energy storage projects.

  

This role emphasizes end\-to\-end SCADA engineering for BESS facilities, including integration with Energy Management Systems (EMS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and utility communication systems. The candidate will support conceptual and detailed engineering activities including controls architecture, network design, communications, telemetry, data mapping, and system integration across the full project lifecycle.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Develop engineering design documents and deliverables for SCADA systems supporting BESS projects.
* Design and coordinate SCADA system architecture integrating BMS, EMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
* Develop control narratives, data mapping, alarms, and monitoring strategies.
* Lead and participate in design reviews (30%, 60%, 90%, IFC).
* Coordinate SCADA scope with utility interconnection and grid compliance requirements.
* Support vendor selection, specifications, and design reviews.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to junior engineers.
* Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities.
* Perform testing, validation, and troubleshooting during commissioning.
* Provide field and remote support to construction teams and clients
**Management Responsibilities**
-------------------------------


**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience with utility\-scale BESS projects.
* Familiarity with EMS, BMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
* Experience with SEL RTAC and related hardware.
* Knowledge of DNP3, Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850\.
* Knowledge of NERC CIP, PRC\-028, IEEE 2800 standards.
* Experience with SCADA network and fiber systems.
* Experience with commissioning multi\-vendor systems.
* Experience with HMI platforms such as Ignition or AVEVA.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.

**Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5\+ years SCADA engineering experience.
* 3\+ years experience with utility\-scale BESS projects.
* Experience with SCADA design and commissioning activities.
**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------


Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 5 years related work experience. title: ITAO, AVP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title:** **ITAO**

**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Role Description**

IT Application Owner is responsible for identifying and Assessing the current state technological infrastructure for gaps or potential improvements using their knowledge of infrastructure solutions and where industry innovations are in their lifecycles. Work includes:


* Determining the appropriate technological solutions to balance delivery and compliance
* Identifying gaps in the current infrastructure solutions and implementing the associated improvements whilst ensuring compliance with technical roadmaps Improving the safety and security of IT Applications, compliance with internal and external standards and operational readiness
* Supporting the bank’s audit function in the remediation of audit points and issues in order to reduce risk
* Identifying and assessing IT Application risk and implementing the associated technology measures
* Contributing and assisting the implementation of policy and strategy specific to IT management and Information Security
* Identifying opportunities to incorporate new technologies/approaches into best practice

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,


* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your key responsibilities**

The IT Application Owner (ITAO) plays a crucial role in managing the compliance of one or more application instances under their control throughout their entire lifecycle.


**As an ITAO, you will:**

* Act as the primary contact for application\-related requests from various Bank teams, covering areas such as IT compliance attestations, information security attestations, disaster recovery coordination, and patching coordination.
* Own and manage the backlog of IT management and compliance tasks, working closely with development teams for effective remediation.
* Manage multiple stakeholders (Including Business, Security, Development, Testing (QA), IT Support, Finance, external Vendors and Architecture) to ensure regulatory compliance, operational smoothness, and a robust development lifecycle for the application.
* Ensure the application is compliant with the Bank’s IT policies and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Support the development team in maintaining high service availability and stability of the application.

**Your skills and experience**

* Strong time management and project coordination skills, with the ability to keep multiple tasks on track and manage several work streams simultaneously.
* Excellent interpersonal and collaborative skills, capable of communicating effectively at all levels, from auditors and engineers to support staff and senior management.
* Very good presentation and communication skills in English.
* Highly organised and self\-driven, with strong analytical abilities.
* Basic technical background and understanding of servers, storages, networks, databases, UNIX, and Windows.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts; experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.
* Good understanding of information security concepts.
* Over 2 years of experience in a global IT organization, with hands\-on experience in Project Management, Application Management, Governance, Software Development, or Operations.
* ITIL or other IT, Information Security or Project Management certifications are a plus.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:


**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.


Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.


We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**


**Location\- Pune**


### **What you will do**



As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.



The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.


**How you will do it:**


* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.


**What we look for:**


**Required**


* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.
* Familiarity with service now Ticketing and CMDB is desirable
* Demonstrated capability to take part as lead security engineer in multi\-phase / multi\-year network projects or programs, leading these projects to successful implementation.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skill.
* Strong vendor management experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills to provide clear messages to all levels.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain strategic working relationships with peers and constituents at all levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated analysis and problem solving skills using innovative thinking.
* Knowledge of ITIL based practices.
* Knowledge of Python and automation skills are desirable.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other applicable discipline.
* 8\&\#43; years of proven, hands\-on network security experience at global enterprise organizations, including significant experience owning and operating a Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA) environment at scale.
* Network security Professional level certification preferred (e.g. Zscaler ZDTA/ZCCP/ZCCA, Fortinet NSE, Imperva, etc.); Zscaler certification strongly preferred.
* CISSP, CEH, CISM or CISA certifications is a plus.


Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view\[ EEO is the Law](https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/migrated\_files/employers/poster\_screen\_reader\_optimized.pdf). If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit \[www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers).

title: Global Internet Planning Engineer-Pune VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking an experienced Global Internet Planning Engineer to support the planning, design, optimisation, and lifecycle management of Vodafone Group's global Internet network (AS1273\). This role is ideal for a network professional with strong expertise in Internet capacity planning, Layer 3 network design, traffic analysis, and telecommunications infrastructure. The successful candidate will work closely with global stakeholders, transmission teams, engineering teams, and local operating companies to deliver resilient, scalable, and cost\-effective network solutions while contributing to automation and continuous improvement initiatives

**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Monitor Internet network traffic demand and plan bandwidth upgrades to support business and customer requirements.
* Lead Internet capacity planning and network design activities for Vodafone Group Internet network (AS1273\).
* Analyse network performance, prepare capacity reports and dashboards, identify traffic hotspots, and develop resilience plans to minimise service disruption.
* Collaborate with transmission and submarine capacity planning teams to design, deliver, and validate new network capacities.
* Develop pre\-sales network solutions and assess customer traffic profiles to recommend appropriate Internet connectivity solutions.
* Deliver project planning, solution design, Bill of Quantity (BoQ), and Bill of Material (BoM) preparation for network expansion, device deployment, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Engage with local operating companies, partner networks, engineering teams, and stakeholders throughout the network design and delivery lifecycle.
* Support the implementation and configuration of global network nodes through established change management processes.
* Plan and deliver network hardware lifecycle management programmes, including equipment refresh, migration, and risk mitigation activities.
* Coordinate software upgrades and hardware modernisation initiatives to ensure network stability and vendor compliance.
* Produce Internet exchange resilience reporting and performance metrics for regulatory and business stakeholders.
* Design optimisation and customer migration solutions that support strategic network transformation and cost efficiencies.
* Review capacity requirements across interconnect platforms including DIAoMSP NNI, SISA, and B2B connectivity environments.
* Support annual bandwidth forecasting, business case preparation, and investment planning activities.
* Conduct traffic analysis for peering and content delivery networks using tools such as Deepfield to optimise network performance and identify growth opportunities.
* Support Internet cyber defence initiatives through traffic monitoring, analysis, and migration activities associated with network protection programmes.
* Contribute to automation initiatives, workflow simplification, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) activities for workflow and process enhancements.
* Develop Power Apps and automation solutions for cost management, inventory management, and process optimisation.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Engineering or Science graduate with relevant telecommunications or network engineering experience.
* 7\-8 years of experience in Global Internet Capacity Planning and Network Design.
* Strong knowledge of Layer 3 networking technologies and Internet infrastructure.
* Experience working with Juniper and Cisco routing platforms.
* Understanding of transmission networks, DWDM, OTN, and data centre connectivity environments.
* Knowledge of network change management processes and governance frameworks.
* Experience with inventory and workflow management platforms such as Cramer, MORI, or similar systems.
* Ability to interpret network requirements and develop practical, scalable design solutions.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving capability, and attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management and communication skills with experience collaborating across multinational teams.
* Experience in Power BI development and data visualisation.
* Experience developing solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Knowledge of scripting and network automation technologies.
* CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent networking certification is preferred.
* OSS/BSS platform knowledge or relevant certifications, including Amdocs or Cramer, are advantageous.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to work on one of the world's largest global Internet networks supporting international connectivity and digital services.
* Exposure to global stakeholders, multinational teams, and diverse network environments.
* Involvement in strategic network transformation, optimisation, and resilience programmes.
* Participation in emerging automation and digitalisation initiatives that improve operational efficiency.
* Opportunity to influence network investment planning, capacity strategy, and technology lifecycle decisions.
* Experience working across Internet, transmission, peering, content delivery, and cyber defence domains.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced Internet capacity planning and traffic engineering techniques.
* Global\-scale network architecture and resilience planning.
* Network lifecycle management and infrastructure modernisation strategies.
* Business case development, forecasting, and network investment planning.
* Advanced network analytics, dashboarding, and performance reporting using Power BI.
* Automation, workflow development, and low\-code application design through Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Cross\-functional stakeholder engagement and global project delivery practices.
* Internet peering, CDN optimisation, and cyber defence traffic management methodologies.
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------



Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

**Join Us**

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

title: Data Architect
description:
**Your role**
-------------

**About us**
------------

Atlas Copco is a Swedish multinational industrial company that was founded in 1873 headquartered in Nacka, Sweden. We are world leaders in Compressors; we also manufacture industrial tools and equipment.


We are an IT Service Provider company within Atlas Copco Group called Global IT Hub (India). We are also focusing on Digital transformation Technologies for Data Driven Decisions, Web and Applications developments, Automations, IT Infrastructure etc.


Data Analytics Competence is the competence within the Global IT Hub (India).


**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Solution Architect to join our growing Data \& Aanlytics team from Digital Technology vertical. In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative data solutions that support our data analytics initiatives. You will bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, ensuring our data infrastructure is scalable, secure, and optimized for advanced analytics.


### **The Role**

* **Bridges the gap:** Translates business needs into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* **Designs the roadmap:** Define and implement scalable, secure data architectures for analytics platforms and BI solutions.
* **Technology expertise:** Possesses deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for optimal performance.
* **Integration champion:** Designs solutions that integrate seamlessly with existing IT infrastructure.
* **Scalability focus:** Keeps scalability and future growth in mind when designing the architecture.
* **Collaboration king:** Works closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to ensure everyone's on the same page.
* **Risk assessment:** Identifies potential risks and proposes solutions to mitigate them.
* **Communication is key:** Clearly communicates complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Innovation:** Stays at part with emerging trends in data and analytics to future\-proof solutions.

**Key responsibilities and accountabilities**
---------------------------------------------

### **Skills and Experience**

* **Data Modelling \& Design:** Expertise in data modelling techniques, including relational (SQL) and non\-relational (NoSQL) databases.
* **Data Warehousing \& ETL:** Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and big data technologies.
* **Programming Languages:** Proficiency in SQL and potentially scripting languages like Python, Spark, etc. for data manipulation and automation.
* **Cloud Platforms:** Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure, Data Bricks, Fabric) for deploying and managing data solutions.
* **Data Management \& Security:** Understanding of data governance, security best practices, and data access controls.
* Certifications: good to have relavent certifications which shows academic regor e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks Certified Solution Architect

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

### **Competences**

* **Communication \& Collaboration:** Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking:** Ability to analyze complex data problems and design effective solutions.
* **Project Management:** Experience managing data\-related projects and ensuring successful execution.
* **Teamwork:** Ability to guide \& collaborate effectively with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business teams.
* **Strategic thinking** and E **nterprise\-level solution design**

### **Stakeholder management**

* You can discuss with stakeholders about their requirements and clearly communicate back your understanding of the requirements.
* You can work with the stakeholders to understand the big picture and work towards it.
* Work with team members and other users from the organization at different levels for performance improvement and suggestions.

### **Must have**

* Communication skills, Facilitation: Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between technical and non\-technical stakeholders (business users, data engineers, analysts, data scientists).
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing across the data team.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse complex business needs and translate them into technical solutions for data analytics projects.
* Technical Architecture Design: Skilled at designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, platforms, and tools to support data analytics at an enterprise level.
* Technology Selection: Deep knowledge of various data technologies (cloud platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, analytics tools) to recommend the best fit for specific needs.

### **Nice to have**

* Emerging Technologies: Curiosity and interest in keeping up with emerging data technologies.
* Experience in hybrid environments: cloud \+ on\-prem
* Business Acumen: Understanding of core business processes and how data analytics can drive strategic decision\-making.
* Project Management Tools: Experience with project management methodologies and tools like Agile or Scrum.
* Mentorship: Ability to mentor and guide junior team members within the data team.

### **Education**

* Any Graduate (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MTech/BSc/MSc/MCS) in Engineering with 8\+ years of experience in software development/data analytics domain and at least 5 years of experience as a solution architect on IT Projects.

### **Knowledge**

* Good analytical skills: You feel comfortable working with numbers/data, e.g. collecting and analysing trend graphs, combining the info with insights from ERP and previous site visits to come to a sound conclusion.
* You are fluent in English: both written and spoken.

### **Personality requirements**

* You like open communication and enjoy working with different cultures.
* You are decisive (not afraid of making errors and willing to learn by doing)
* Open minded; expect the unexpected (\= stay sceptical when viewing at the data and info)
* Not afraid to approach other stakeholders (customer centre specialists, local engineering, or technical support specialists)
* You work with a structured approach when collecting info and data, but also when closing the feedback loop to further increase your learning.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

**What we offer**
-----------------

* This is a leadership role focused on defining roadmap of Data Engineering competence and achieving it.
* Global exposure and opportunities
* This role is ideal for you, if you wish to challenge yourself on Technological front and creating competence centre for Data Engineering and Visualization
* This role gives you enough opportunities to build your professional network among technical fraternity within the group.
* This role also expects you to build a very strong network of local ecosystem and bring the benefits for Atlas Copco
* Flexible working hours
* Flexible office and home working policies
* A modern infrastructure providing you with the latest tools and technologies at your disposal.
* A challenging environment which contributes to your constant learning and professional growth
* To be part of the data competence team which is constantly growing.
* Depending on the country you are enrolled in group healthcare insurance plans covering your medical needs.
* A chance to become part of a global, innovative company, supporting sustainable productivity.
* You get the opportunity to bring revolutionary ideas fostering innovation and execute qualified ideas.
* A friendly culture with immense professional and personal development, education, and opportunities for career growth
* Free access to LinkedIn Learning and many other internal and external trainings
* Atlas Copco offers trainings on a regular basis to acquire new skills.
* You get the opportunity to make the world a better place through our sustainable goals and by contributing and being part of our Water for all projects.
* Friendly and open culture of Swedish company. Very high visibility in the organization with "No door" culture, you can always talk to anyone in the organization.
* Free canteen and transport facility.

**Job location**

title: Senior Vice President - Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP)
description:
Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (CIP), Pune


Senior Vice President


Pune, India


**About Infrastructure Technology**

The Global Infrastructure organization builds and maintains the critical technology backbone that enables Jefferies to operate at scale, delivering secure, resilient, and high\-performing IT services that power the business. We drive innovation through solutions such as cloud and hybrid adoption, network resiliency, platform modernization, and automation. The organization is structured into several specialized sub\-domains: Core Infrastructure Platform, Public Cloud, Digital Workspace, Networking, Telecom \& Multimedia, and International Infrastructure. Our teams collaborate globally to ensure Jefferies’ technology platforms are highly available, secure, scalable, and cost\-effective.


**Core Infrastructure Platforms**

The Core Infrastructure Platforms function lays the foundation for Jefferies’ IT, designing, operating, and optimizing the essential compute, storage, operating systems, and database platforms that support all business\-critical applications. Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)  

	+

**Education**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred.  

* 

**What Success Looks Like**

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You lead actively, commanding incidents, delivering solutions, and growing your team’s technical and operational capability. You are trusted by engineers as a technical authority, by CIO/BU leaders as a business partner, and by the enterprise as the leader who enables robust, scalable solutions tightly aligned with the business's needs.  



**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Jefferies values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
